response.body:
## Confirmed native identity loss

MediaDive's explicit nested-solution branch substitutes a unified/legacy name match before retaining the source solution_id. This replaces998 source recipe endpoints with generic ingredient, ontology or compound concepts despite the native record identifying a particular stock solution.

Examples: solution1801 is32g sea salt plus1000ml water but is replaced by ENVO seawater; solution5695 is4.5g FeNa-EDTA plus1000ml water but replaced by a compound ID; solution6612 is100mg IAA in100ml ethanol but replaced by IAA itself.

## Full, independently verified scope

-39,879 native source recipe observations, all joined to current full source rows.
-4,806 nested references:998 would change,3,808 already retain native IDs.
-35,073 compound observations remain outside this fix.
-998 changes involve280 child IDs;279 already have native declarations.
-All active substitutions select unified mappings;29 also admit a conflicting legacy fallback.
-Repeated references remain distinct by raw source-list position; no cycles or duplicated assertion IDs were found.

Three child records are absent from the selected export:2269,6420,6572. Only2269 lacks a current declaration. Preserve cited native IDs and labels as explicitly unresolved, audited source referents, not invented formulations. Missing required input files must still abort; do not silently fetch unpinned online replacements.

## Required upstream fix

For every explicit nested solution_id, preserve mediadive.solution:<id> before/bypassing both name-lookup routes. Carry that identity through actual node/edge emission and source finalization. Preserve all occurrence IDs, quantities, raw evidence and compound processing.

Add complete nested-identity conservation and missing-child audits bound to admitted source bytes. Test successful/conflicting mappings, repeated child references, no-recipe children, missing-child evidence, malformed IDs, cache/input/audit mutation, repeat-finalization and recorded admission. Explain auxiliary node/enrichment changes in full producer replay;998 is not a promised net edge-count change.

No semantic edits after merge. Oatmeal/Substrate issues #1317/#1318 affect six separate compound occurrences and must retain independent accounting.

Evidence:

Implementation and fresh finalized producer/merged acceptance remain pending.
response.title: MediaDive: preserve explicit nested recipe IDs instead of substituting name-mapped ingredients
